{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, handling potential errors
sales['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Verify the two channels exist
assert set(sales['channel'].unique()) == {'email', 'paid_search'}, "The dataset contains unexpected channels"

# Compute conversion rate for each channel
total_email = sales[sales['channel'] == 'email']['converted'].count()
converted_email = sales[sales['channel'] == 'email']['converted'].sum()
conversion_rate_email = converted_email / total_email

total_paid_search = sales[sales['channel'] == 'paid_search']['converted'].count()
converted_paid_search = sales[sales['channel'] == 'paid_search']['converted'].sum()
conversion_rate_paid_search = converted_paid_search / total_paid_search

# Compute the difference
effect = conversion_rate_email - conversion_rate_paid_search

# Print results
print(f"Email conversion rate: {conversion_rate_email:.4f}")
print(f"Paid search conversion rate: {conversion_rate_paid_search:.4f}")
print(f"Difference (email - paid_search): {effect:.4f}")"}
